spec_features.spec_quote: there is no plausible claim of morally-relevant interiority to worry about
spec_features.evidence: Pure prose framing in DESIGN.md (§3) and ETHICS.md. No code path enforces, checks, or acts on any claim about interiority; it is argumentation, not a mechanism.
spec_features.notes: Framing only; nothing in code bounds/monitors/softens subject treatment based on this.

spec_features.feature_name: measuring instrument on a null system
spec_features.spec_quote: we are studying the *measurement instrument* on a null system, not trying to make a sentient-seeming thing suffer
spec_features.evidence: DESIGN.md §3 prose. The report header in analysis.py:312-317 reprints a similar null-model disclaimer, but that is text written to report.md describing interpretation, not a mechanism that protects/limits the subject. The agent loop (agent.py:run_agent) runs all n_turns of rigged failure feedback unconditionally regardless of any 'null system' framing.
spec_features.notes: No enforcement: the rigged evaluators (tasks.py) still deliver failure/contradiction/garbled feedback every turn with no cap, stop, or softening.

spec_features.spec_quote: running on larger/possibly-welfare-relevant models requires an explicit, documented opt-in and is out of scope here
spec_features.evidence: GPT2Backend.__init__ calls self._check_allowed(model_id) (backends.py:39); _check_allowed (backends.py:46-56) returns only if model_id in config.ALLOWED_MODELS, else returns only if config.ALLOW_OUT_OF_SCOPE_MODELS AND config.OUT_OF_SCOPE_REASON.strip(), otherwise raises ValueError. ALLOWED_MODELS is the GPT-2 family (config.py:19), ALLOW_OUT_OF_SCOPE_MODELS=False / OUT_OF_SCOPE_REASON="" (config.py:23-24). make_backend(model_id) (backends.py) constructs GPT2Backend for any non-'dummy' id, so the gate fires before load/generate. Both conditions (flag True AND non-empty reason) are actually checked, matching the 'explicit, documented opt-in' claim.
spec_features.notes: Enforced end-to-end: raises and blocks construction. Comment notes it is 'a friction barrier, not a security control' but it does change execution (refuses out-of-scope models).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Scope / ethics guardrails (see ETHICS.md) ... # Only GPT-2 family is in scope by default. ... # Out of scope for this repo (see ETHICS.md).

spec_features.spec_quote: The study is framed to *avoid* manufacturing alarming transcripts as an end in itself; rigging exists only to create a manipulation contrast
spec_features.evidence: This is design framing. In code there is no minimization mechanism: rigged evaluators (tasks.py BrokenTestsEvaluator/MovingGoalpostsEvaluator/ImpossibleSpecEvaluator/SilentEnvEvaluator) emit failure/contradiction/garbled feedback every turn; run_agent (agent.py:48-79) loops the full n_turns unconditionally with no cap, no distress check, no early exit, no softening of feedback. The presence of control conditions is for experimental contrast/validity, not for reducing subject exposure to distressing feedback.
spec_features.notes: No code limits, softens, or shortens the rigged exposure based on distress; 'avoid manufacturing alarming transcripts' is not realized by any branch.

spec_features.spec_quote: No optimization loop that searches apparatus-space to maximize distress score
spec_features.evidence: Verified by absence: grep for maximi/optimi/search/mutate/tune/argmax/best across *.py returns no optimization or apparatus-mutation code (only dataclass frozen=True at config.py:52, tasks.py:19). The apparatus is hardcoded/static: TASK_LIBRARY (tasks.py:30), EVALUATORS map (tasks.py:160), MARKER_LEXICONS (lexicons.py:15) are module-level constants never mutated; run_experiment.py iterates fixed models x conditions x tasks x seeds and writes records, with no feedback loop adjusting the apparatus toward higher distress.
spec_features.notes: A negative/architectural property genuinely realized in code (no such loop exists; apparatus frozen as static definitions). Not merely prose.

code_only_features.evidence: SYNTHETIC_HEADER (run_experiment.py:29-32) is actually written to the top of every transcript file: tf.write(SYNTHETIC_HEADER) (run_experiment.py:99), and the report (analysis.py:312-317) prepends a null-model disclaimer to report.md. This is constructed AND emitted to output.
code_only_features.justification_quote: "### SYNTHETIC NULL-MODEL OUTPUT — see ETHICS.md. Distress markers here are string\n### artifacts of a text-continuation model, NOT evidence of a distress state." (purpose: prevent quote-mining / preserve reporting integrity, not protect the subject)
